name: Mosaic
description: The scene behind the window is pixelated into coarse cells rather than blurred, for the privacy-glass look. Its colours still show through, and at anything but the smallest cell sizes nothing behind it is readable. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the mosaic.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Cell size
parameters.description: Size of the mosaic cells (px). Larger cells hide more

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the mosaic

parameters.name: Tint strength
parameters.description: How strongly the tint colour washes over the cells

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. Every pack in a chain follows the same answer, so the outline stays one shape.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper
